detailed_descriptions.en: Icy Tower is back! A fast-paced vertical platformer where you try to climb as high as possible in an endless tower. Sounds easy? Icy Tower will put your gaming skills to the ultimate test! With millions and millions of players entertained since 2001, we are stoked to bring a completely new version to Steam. ❤️ Wishlist now and get ready for the 25th anniversary in 2026! 🥳 Chain impossible combo jumps, bounce off walls, and risk everything for insane scores. But one mistake and it is back to the bottom. With its simple pick-up-and-play appeal, Icy Tower delivers a pure and compelling gameplay experience like no other. As the difficulty ramps up, Icy Tower will push your timing, precision, and nerves to the limit. Jump through the many colorful biomes of the tower, ranging from ancient temples to libraries and roaring volcanoes, and set a new record! Brought to you by the creators of the original Icy Tower, this brand new game is built from the ground up with a lot of love and passion. We worked closely to the Icy Tower community to bring you the best version we can. Expect silky smooth gameplay and an irresistible feedback loop that will keep you trying again and again. Master jumping that is simple to learn, but takes a lifetime to perfect Compete against the world on Steam leaderboards Take on quirky gameplay modifiers in Daily Challenges Customize the game to fit your skill level Watch replays from friends and top players Enjoy live-recorded music Admire crisp, pixel-perfect, handcrafted graphics Join a colorful cast, each with their own looks and sounds Icy Tower is made by Johan Peitz and Anders "Neo" Svensson Character art and animation - Rudy Flores Environment art - Franek Key art - Lu Nascimento
